description.en: Calls WaitLoading on every handle in the given array, one after another — waits for all of them to finish loading.
Array of handles to wait on the loading state of.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Wait for every model in an array to finish loading
WaitLoadingArray([hCharaL, hCharaR, hBallL]);
